pois.title: Suntik Village
pois.name: Suntik Village

The town was overrun by Monougas at some point prior to Release. The townsfolk were slain by the invaders. pois.name: Mount Syliph
pois.desc: === Description === One of the mountains in the Mount Alphus Range. A portal to the Syliph Tower dungeon can be found to the south of the mountain. === Route ===

pois.title: Mount Dalt
pois.name: Mount Dalt
pois.desc: === Description === One of the mountains in the Mount Alphus Range. Portals to Mount Gemm and Mount Syliph can be found to the north and south of the mountain respectively. === Route ===

pois.title: Wilderness Fort
pois.name: Wilderness Fort
pois.desc:
=== Description === A fort at 23.5N, 7.7W near Zaikhal, with NPCs and a lifestone. The fort also had portals to Hebian-To and Zaikhal, but they were destroyed during the Shifting Gears event.
Design of the fort is like that of the walls of Bandit Castle.

pois.title: Mount Gemm
pois.name: Mount Gemm
pois.desc: === Description === One of the mountains in the Mount Alphus Range. Portals to Mount Bellig and Mount Dalt can be found to the north and south of the mountain respectively. === Route ===
